passages.heading: **Baseline characteristics**
passages.text: The cohort consisted of 7921 participants, with average age of 60.79 ± 12.18, and 3866(48.81%) males. During an average follow-up period of 9.75 years, there were 1,911 deaths (24.13%), with 585 cases attributed to cardiovascular diseases. The detailed information was shown in the Table 1. In terms of lifestyle, there are differences between the all-cause mortality group and the cardiovascular disease mortality group and the alive group.
